## Overview

Builds the `org.Omykiss.eg.db` annotation package that the trout sections of
`06_go.Rmd` consume. Same BioMart → AnnotationForge pipeline as `99a` but
keyed against the `omykiss_gene_ensembl` dataset and `tax_id = 8022`.

## Packages

```{r r_packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(AnnotationForge)  # makeOrgPackage()
library(biomaRt)          # getBM() Ensembl query
library(tidyverse)        # table wrangling
```

## Fetch annotation from BioMart

```{r fetch_biomart, cache=TRUE}
# One BioMart query (gene IDs, GO + evidence, symbols, descriptions,
# chromosomes) against the trout Ensembl dataset.
tbl_trout <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "go_id", "go_linkage_type",
                 "external_gene_name", "description", "chromosome_name"),
  mart = useDataset(dataset = "omykiss_gene_ensembl",
                    mart = useMart("ENSEMBL_MART_ENSEMBL")))
```

## Split into the three AnnotationForge tables

```{r split_tables}
# Gene-info table (GID -> SYMBOL, GENENAME); drop empty symbol/name rows.
gene_info_tbl_trout <- tbl_trout %>%
  dplyr::select(GID = ensembl_gene_id,
                SYMBOL = external_gene_name,
                GENENAME = description) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(SYMBOL != "", GENENAME != "")

# Gene -> chromosome table.
gene_chromosome_tbl_trout <- tbl_trout %>%
  distinct(GID = ensembl_gene_id, CHROMOSOME = chromosome_name)

# Gene -> GO table with evidence; drop empty GO/evidence rows.
gene_GO_tbl_trout <- tbl_trout %>%
  distinct(GID = ensembl_gene_id, GO = go_id, EVIDENCE = "go_linkage_type") %>%
  filter(GO != "", EVIDENCE != "")
```

## Build the OrgDB package

```{r build_orgdb}
# Assemble into an installable OrgDb (org.Omykiss.eg.db); tax_id 8022 = O. mykiss.
AnnotationForge::makeOrgPackage(
  gene_info  = gene_info_tbl_trout,
  chromosome = gene_chromosome_tbl_trout,
  go         = gene_GO_tbl_trout,
  version    = "0.1",
  maintainer = "Some One <so@someplace.org>",
  author     = "Some One <so@someplace.org>",
  outputDir  = ".",
  tax_id     = "8022",
  genus      = "Oncorhynchus",
  species    = "mykiss",
  goTable    = "go")
```

## Install the built package

```{r install_orgdb}
# Install the freshly-built package so 06_go.Rmd can load it.
install.packages("./org.Omykiss.eg.db", repos = NULL, type = "source")
```
